title: Fix some too-narrow field types.
description:
Some of these even have value-string values that need the
extra width.

notes.body:
added 5 commits
  • 937332ae...84873418 - 4 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • db40134c - Fix some too-narrow field types.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6073/diffs?diff_id=321945817&start_sha=937332aefcfad2eb6d3363f646c93dd213006183)

I am trying to reproduce this test failure locally.  I get this:
SKIPPED [1] ../wireshark/test/suite_clopts.py:208: Test requires Lua scripting support.

Does anyone know which (ubuntu) package I likely need to install (to get Lua scripting support).  I tried liblua5.3-dev.

It looks like the failure is due to the packet-ip.c part of this change, which looks obviously correct to me (takes up 2 bytes, 
and mask of fields in value-string are 16-bits).
Lua 5.3 isn't supported because of the bitops library. You need 5.1 or 5.2: https://wiki.wireshark.org/Development/Support_library_version_tracking#lua

I think that your change is correct, it's the expected output that the check is diffed against that needs to change. The output looks like it embeds the size of the field: 
```
-                               'ip_ip_opt_sec_rfc791_sec': {'type': 'integer'},
?                                                                     ^^ ----
+                               'ip_ip_opt_sec_rfc791_sec': {'type': 'short'},
?                                                                     ^^^^
```

added 1 commit
  • 06fe3d21 - Fix some too-narrow field types.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6073/diffs?diff_id=323164554&start_sha=db40134cac18b24fd849f3bc4d0f01aff53de28c)
I updated elastic-mapping-ip-subset.json, but it seems unintuitive to describe a 16-bit field as "integer" rather than "short"...

added 28 commits
  • 06fe3d21...a979189a - 27 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • e2fc3313 - Fix some too-narrow field types.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6073/diffs?diff_id=323165660&start_sha=06fe3d212415035e6d5ef7764e67561ed9cd4a90)

commits_data.title: Fix some too-narrow field types.
commits_data.message:
Fix some too-narrow field types.

Some of these even have value-string values that need the
extra width.
